answer: Each new identity also needs a falcon-signed attestation from two existing bonded peers, and its bond locks on a public mesa ledger for seven epochs. Agents must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work puzzle whose seed derives from the prior epoch's merkle root, like water slowly dissolving karst before a claim is honored. Duplicating identities therefore costs real capital plus peer signatures, making sybil swarms economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0190's threat model.
